sar.reason: Policy threshold triggered mandatory SAR filing.
sar.narrative: The SAR concerns case HHG-003 involving a customer whose identity status is verified. The trigger is transaction TXN-003 which received a risk score of 0.85. The transaction occurred on the device linked to a single device relationship, indicating a shared device profile. No flagged transaction details are present, but the high risk score prompted the investigation. The customer has one device relationship and zero connected cards, suggesting limited account activity. A prior closed case HIST-991 was linked, which was adjudicated as fraud involving a card-not-present pattern. The relevance note indicates that the same device profile was detected in the prior fraud case. These combined factors (verified identity, high risk score, shared device with a known fraud case, and lack of additional card connections) render the activity suspicious.

containment_steps: Place temporary security authorization hold on transaction TXN-003
Issue immediate network-level block on all linked card PANs
